articles.summary: International Bancshares Corporation (NASDAQ: IBOC) (“IBC”) announced today that its Board of Directors approved the declaration of a $0.73 per share cash dividend for shareholders of record of Common Stock, $1.00 par value, as of the close of business on Feb. 13, 2026, payable on Feb. 27, 2026. This is an increase of 4.3% per share from the previous cash dividend.
articles.title: International Bancshares Corporation Announces 4.3% Increase in Cash Dividend
